title: Book Blue Loft | 3 Bed 3 Bath Rosemary Beach Condo | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: This charming 3 bed, 3 bath Rosemary Beach condo affetionately named Blue Loft is a perfect getaway space for a family. Click to see inside this spacious condo and book a stay!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach Racquet Club also included

Magazine-Worthy Interiors — Major Renovations in 2025

Affectionately known as “Blue Loft,” this beautifully updated 3-bedroom retreat now features a brand-new chef’s kitchen, new hardwood flooring throughout the main level, and a stylish new bar adjacent to the kitchen. Luxurious furnishings and thoughtful appointments fill every room. The gorgeous primary suite offers a private sanctuary with a king bed and opulent en-suite bathroom and a bonus lofted living space with a new Crate & Barrel queen sleeper sofa, card table area and wet bar.

The contemporary main living area impresses with soaring ceilings, new hardwood floors, and beach-chic décor. Relax between two plush sofas and matching armchairs, and enjoy movie nights on the 65” wall-mounted TV.

The brand-new kitchen is a showpiece, boasting modern cabinetry, premium appliances, and elevated finishes. Mornings are a delight at the breakfast bar with seating for four. The adjacent dining area seats six comfortably, and the newly added custom bar near the kitchen makes entertaining effortless.

This condo now sleeps up to eight guests across three beautifully finished bedrooms and the upstairs loft.

Primary Bedroom (Upstairs): King bed, 39” TV, private balcony, and a luxe en-suite with Carrera marble, glass tile, and a walk-in shower.

Upstairs Loft: Crate & Barrel queen sleeper sofa.

Bedroom 2 (Entry Level): Queen bed and flat-screen TV.A guest bathroom with a tub/shower combination serves the main living level.

Bedroom 3 (Entry Level): King bed, flat-screen TV, and a private en-suite bathroom with walk-in shower.

Step outside to the private balcony and savor the warm coastal breeze. With ample seating and tables, it’s an ideal spot for casual dining, cocktails, and conversation after a day of adventure.

A dedicated parking spot is located behind the building.

All the charm of Rosemary Beach is at your doorstep—local eateries, boutiques, and the popular Farmers' Market are just a 2-minute stroll away.

Disclaimer: Active balcony construction on neighboring building during January-Mid-April 2026.
